 Diwali 2026 calendar: Dates, puja muhurat and rituals for Dhanteras, Lakshmi Puja and Bhai Dooj
 Updated on: Nov 4, 2026, 23:15:14 IST By Kanakanjali Roy Prefer HT on Google Share via 
 Copy link 
 Diwali 2026 calendar: Dates, puja muhurat and rituals for Dhanteras, Lakshmi Puja and Bhai Dooj (Pinterest) From lighting the Yama Deepam on Dhanteras to applying a tilak on your brother's forehead on Bhai Dooj, here is a look at the festival dates and rituals. 
 Diwali is celebrated over several days, with each occasion carrying its own traditions and religious significance. From lighting the Yama Deepam on Dhanteras to applying a tilak on your brother's forehead on Bhai Dooj, here is a look at the festival dates, auspicious timings, and key rituals for Diwali 2026. Yogini Saloni Rajawat has shared the calendar and puja timings on her Instagram.
 ALSO READ: Dhanteras 2026: Why the Yama Deepam is lit separately from the 12 Diwali lamps and what the ritual signifies 
 Dhanteras
 Friday, November 6, 2026
 Muhurat: 6:32 PM to 8:31 PM
 Rituals:
 Light a Yama Deepam at the entrance of your home. 
 Worship Dhanvantari, Goddess Lakshmi, and Lord Kuber. 
 Buy a utensil or an item made of silver or gold. 
 Kali Chaudas
 Saturday, November 7, 2026
 Muhurat: 11:44 PM to 12:36 AM
 Rituals:
 Light a diya for protection. 
 Worship Maa Kali or Lord Hanuman. 
 Pray for the removal of negativity. 
 Narak Chaturdashi/Chhoti Diwali
 Sunday, November 8, 2026
 Muhurat: 5:40 AM to 6:37 AM
 Rituals:
 Take an Abhyanga Snan, a traditional bath with oil and ubtan. 
 Light diyas around your home. 
 Prepare for the main Diwali celebration. 
 Diwali/Lakshmi Puja
 Sunday, November 8, 2026
 Muhurat: 6:25 PM to 8:23 PM
 Rituals:
 Perform Lakshmi-Ganesh Puja. 
 Light diyas across your home. 
 Offer sweets and naivedya (food offerings) to the deities. 
 Govardhan Puja/Padwa
 Monday, November 9, 2026
 Muhurat: 3:42 PM to 5:59 PM
 Rituals:
 Offer Annakut or bhog to Lord Krishna. 
 Celebrate Bali Pratipada, also known as Padwa. 
 Visit a temple or perform a simple puja at home. 
 Bhai Dooj
 Wednesday, November 11, 2026
 Muhurat: 1:26 PM to 3:42 PM
 Rituals:
 Prepare a decorated wooden seat or a platform made with rice flour for your brother. 
 Apply a sacred roli or vermilion tilak on his forehead. 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Saloni Rajawat (@yogini_saloni) 
 Disclaimer: The dates, muhurat, and rituals are based on the calendar provided by the expert mentioned. Puja timings may vary by location, so check your local Panchang before performing the rituals.
